Recorded claim:
For D325951 at revision 70c22cf2ae655bb4eae42f46913239b43bd0168b, the author intended an off-by-default setting that ignores one pointer click on a sortable message-list header and sorts on a double-click. Keyboard sorting, menu actions, resizing, and column rearrangement were intended to keep working. This is the author's stated contract, not independent proof of the implemented behavior or a convention for other revisions.

Provenance: dfd011494f895f579dc47edcdcacc388600aaa2a926570889cf35d6590062d0e. Original evidence IDs: d703c6abf035d9dd238ab13d8a19b0fa01f5bee5b729cada22aff923ccf0c67a.
